answer: WOA Cocktails is a luxury mobile bar serving Miami and New York. We rebuilt its website from scratch, with every page in English and Spanish.

metrics.reviewNote: “2 weeks” comes from the quote signed “Fabio, Website design” on the contact page. Confirm it is Fabio Perez talking about the WOA build.

paragraphs: WOA sells a high-end mobile bar experience, so it needed a website that looked just as polished.
The website is also where customers and the press go to learn about the company.

items.title: Rebuild from scratch
items.bodyHtml: We designed and coded the site ourselves instead of starting from a template. It has large visuals and smooth motion, and the layout was designed for phones first.

items.title: Build every page in two languages
items.bodyHtml: Every page is in English and Spanish, and a toggle in the menu switches languages with one tap.

figure.alt: A WOA Cocktails service page shown in English with a one-tap EN/ES language toggle in the navigation
figure.caption: A WOA service page in English. One tap switches it to Spanish.

items.title: Set it up for Google in both languages
items.bodyHtml: We set up both language versions for search, so WOA shows up whether someone searches in English or in Spanish.

figure.alt: WOA Cocktails English result on Google, with sitelinks for Mobile Bar Experience, Events, Services, and About
figure.caption: WOA on Google in English, with its main pages listed under the result.

quote.text: Working with Button Up Media has been one of the best investments I've made for my business. They completely rebuilt our website for WOA Cocktails, and the final result exceeded my expectations.
quote.name: Fabio Perez
